reference_fields: Ripening Season of Peach Varieties in Massachusetts

Fruit Notes Volume 4, March 1939 archive article giving a Massachusetts peach ripening-season graph with average picking dates, earliest and latest picking extremes, and asterisks for varieties recommended for planting

categories.name: Massachusetts peach ripening season from Fruit Notes 1939
categories.description: Fruit Notes gives a March 1939 graph of Massachusetts peach picking seasons. Bars show average picking dates and x marks show earliest and latest picking dates; asterisks mark varieties recommended for planting in Massachusetts
